slides.headline: “Just get more good reviews.” Here's why that's only half the answer.
Inviting every customer is the long game.
slides.body: It's the right one. Do it.

slides.headline: Every customer — not just the happy ones.
slides.body: Cherry-picking who you invite breaks Trustpilot's rules.

slides.headline: But volume is slow.
slides.body: It can take months of genuine reviews to outweigh one coordinated wave.

slides.headline: Removal is the short game.
slides.body: Reviews that shouldn't be there come down now.

slides.headline: Do both.
slides.body: One builds the score. The other stops it being dragged down.

slides.headline: Send us the link. We'll tell you if it may have a case.
slides.sub: You only pay once it's gone.
